events.text: Prince George became George Cambridge and was styled Earl of Eltham as a courtesy title.
events.subject: self
events.quote: Prince George became George Cambridge and was styled Earl of Eltham as a courtesy title .

events.text: He succeeded his father as 2nd Marquess of Bristol.
events.subject: self
events.quote: He succeeded his father as 2nd Marquess of Bristol on 24 October 1927 .

events.text: He was appointed a Knight Commander of the Royal Victorian Order.
events.subject: self
events.object: Knight Commander of the Royal Victorian Order
events.quote: He was appointed a Knight Commander of the Royal Victorian Order in June 1927

events.text: He was promoted to Knight Grand Cross.
events.subject: self
events.quote: was promoted to Knight Grand Cross in June 1935
